entities.summary: Santa Maria in Trivio is a church in Rome. It is dedicated to Mary, mother of Jesus, and is located on Piazza dei Crociferi in rione Trevi. It is near the Fountain of Trevi. Santa Maria in Trivio is a church building in Europe, established in 1675-03-25. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
